certificates.name: AZMARI MUSIC ACADEMY Diploma in Modern and Traditional Ethiopian Music

weeks.title: What is music? Pitch, beat and staff
weeks.summary: Do–Re–Mi echo singing; steady beat; quarter/half notes; treble staff and note names; hearing melody vs chords.

weeks.title: Keyboard and five-finger position
weeks.summary: Do–Re–Mi–Fa–Sol; 4/4; black-key groups; C five-finger position; C major triad and arpeggio.

weeks.title: Octave and C major scale
weeks.summary: Full movable-do major scale; note values and ties; C major fingering; intervals and I–V harmony.

weeks.title: 3/4, accidentals and first performance
weeks.summary: 3/4 pulse; sharps, flats and naturals; short C-major melody; perform an 8-bar melody and sing solfège.

weeks.title: G major, F major and key signatures
weeks.summary: Transpose movable-do; G and F major; one sharp/one flat; I–IV–V accompaniment; introductory syncopation.

weeks.title: D major and intervals
weeks.summary: D major scale; major/minor/perfect intervals; sixteenth-note patterns; sing and identify intervals.

weeks.title: Qenet and Tizita major
weeks.summary: Pentatonic qenet concept; Tizita major in C/G/D; Do Re Mi Sol La; qenet listening and drone accompaniment.

weeks.title: Bati and Ambassel major
weeks.summary: Bati and Ambassel note sets; compare qenet by ear; syncopation review; Month 2 practical/theory test.

weeks.title: Natural minor scale
weeks.summary: La-based minor solfège; A and E natural minor; 6/8 introduction; minor triads and relative major/minor.

weeks.title: Triads and inversions
weeks.summary: Major, minor, diminished and augmented triads; first/second inversions; smooth voice leading; 6/8 practice.

weeks.title: Minor qenet family
weeks.summary: Tizita minor, Bati minor and Ambassel minor; chromatic solfège; slow 12/8; qenet-based chord colours.

weeks.title: Songs, consolidation and Level 1 exam
weeks.summary: Sight-singing, rhythm reading in 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8; perform C-major and qenet pieces; Level 1 examination.

weeks.title: Seventh chords
weeks.summary: Maj7, dominant 7, minor 7 and half-diminished; arpeggios; chord-tone melodies; syncopation level 2.

weeks.title: Sus, add chords and chord symbols
weeks.summary: Sus2, sus4, add9 and 6 chords; chord symbols and inversions; suspension/resolution; accompaniment patterns.

weeks.title: Anchihoye qenet
weeks.summary: Anchihoye note set and solfège; contrast with Ambassel; 12/8 and 4/4 swing; diminished/augmented colour chords.

weeks.title: All four qenet and Month 4 exam
weeks.summary: Play and sing Tizita, Bati, Ambassel and Anchihoye; qenet chord choices; kebero + clap in 12/8.

weeks.title: Circle of fifths and key signatures
weeks.summary: Transpose melodies; A, E, Bb, Eb and Ab major; relative minors; key signatures up to four sharps/flats.

weeks.title: Essential chord progressions
weeks.summary: I–IV–V–I, I–vi–IV–V, ii–V–I and minor progressions; 16-bar chord charts; bass and chord accompaniment.

weeks.title: Compound rhythms: 6/8 and 12/8
weeks.summary: Compound pulse and subdivisions; ta-ki-da; 3-against-2; dotted rhythms; 12/8 accompaniment patterns.

weeks.title: Regional styles and Ethiopian dance rhythms
weeks.summary: Listening and playing: Eskista, Chiqchiqa, Gurage, Oromo, Tigrigna, Azmari and modern Ethiopian jazz/pop; Month 5 test.

weeks.title: Form and song structure
weeks.summary: Motifs, 8-bar periods, verse–chorus, AABA, strophic and call-and-response; cadences and rubato.

weeks.title: Improvisation on a qenet
weeks.summary: Improvise on Tizita, Bati, Ambassel or Anchihoye over drone/loop; apply the 4 S: Space, Shape, Sound, Story.

weeks.title: Arranging for keyboard and small band
weeks.summary: Counter-melody, intro/outro, bass lines, chord voicings and percussion; arrange 16 bars for voice, keys, bass and percussion.

weeks.title: Recording and Level 2 examination
weeks.summary: Click-track performance; basic recording and file management; qenet, harmony, rhythm, solfège and arrangement exam.

weeks.title: Extended harmony
weeks.summary: Scales in 12 keys; 9th/11th/13th chords; shell/rootless voicings; ensemble tuning and unison qenet.

weeks.title: Modes and modal harmony
weeks.summary: Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian and Locrian; modal vamps; 12/8 grooves; harmony vocals.

weeks.title: Chromatic melody and secondary dominants
weeks.summary: Chromatic passing notes, enclosures and secondary dominants; syncopated bass/drum patterns; full-band groove.

weeks.title: Modulation and motif development
weeks.summary: Pivot-chord, direct and circle-of-fifths modulation; tempo changes and rubato; add a key-change section.

weeks.title: Borrowed chords and reharmonisation
weeks.summary: Modal interchange, iv, bVI and bVII; tritone substitution introduction; parallel/contrary motion.

weeks.title: Harmonising Ethiopian qenet
weeks.summary: Drone, diatonic-chord and colour-chord methods; harmonise Tizita, Bati, Ambassel and Anchihoye.

weeks.title: Traditional ornaments and odd meters
weeks.summary: Trills, slides and turns; pedal point/drone; 5/8, 7/8 and 9/8; ensemble odd-meter groove practice.

weeks.title: Transcription project
weeks.summary: Transcribe a short recording by ear; analyse chords; qenet dictation; present transcription to class.

weeks.title: Azmari poetry and sem-ena-werq
weeks.summary: Write a short verse with surface/hidden meaning; free-time phrasing; qenet refrain; voice + krar + kebero.

weeks.title: Advanced improvisation
weeks.summary: Develop motifs, call-and-response, quoting and variation; improvise over ii–V–I and qenet loops.

weeks.title: Songwriting: lyrics, melody and chords
weeks.summary: Write verse/chorus/bridge; choose harmony for emotional tension/release; present a song idea to ensemble.

weeks.title: Mid-Level-3 consolidation and concert
weeks.summary: Review advanced harmony, rhythm and solfège; perform and submit 32-bar original song/arrangement.

weeks.title: Arranging for a band
weeks.summary: Score layout, transposing instruments, ranges, doubling and texture; rehearse traditional melody arrangement.

weeks.title: Voicing and orchestration
weeks.summary: Keyboard, guitar, krar, brass/wind voicings; sectionals and wind/string parts.

weeks.title: Conducting and bandleading
weeks.summary: Conduct 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8; cues and tempo setting; student-led ensemble turns.

weeks.title: Sound system and live audio
weeks.summary: Microphone technique, DI, mixer, monitor mix and signal flow; ensemble sound check.

weeks.title: Traditional–modern fusion
weeks.summary: Combine qenet melody, modern groove and jazz harmony; rehearse fusion repertoire.

weeks.title: Music production
weeks.summary: DAW basics, MIDI, audio editing, tempo maps, basic EQ/reverb and stereo ensemble recording.

weeks.title: Music business and rights
weeks.summary: Copyright, royalties, song registration, contracts and performance rights; practical music-business awareness.

weeks.title: Stage craft and audience
weeks.summary: Stage presence, introductions, storytelling, eye contact and microphone technique; dress rehearsal.

weeks.title: Final polish and coaching
weeks.summary: Individual coaching on solo repertoire; final ensemble rehearsal and performance preparation.

weeks.title: Programme, publicity and recording masters
weeks.summary: Programme notes, poster/publicity, final recording masters and technical rehearsal.

weeks.title: Final theory exam and concert preparation
weeks.summary: Final theory exam, solo preparation, warm-up and full concert soundcheck.

weeks.title: Portfolio, graduation and diploma
weeks.summary: Review practice log, videos and reflections; final concert, graduation and next-step plan.
